description: Save a named email segment so the owner can reuse it from Send to. match is any (people with at least one of tags) or all (people with every tag); exclude leaves out anyone with those tags. Use tag key values from list_contact_tag_options. Leave out id to create a segment; pass an id from list_email_segments to change one. Names are unique, and a business can save up to 50.
name: save_email_segment
